name: Endpoint-Dependent Obfuscation and Exhaustion Trap
description: Replaces the uniform edge constraint with a formula explicitly using the edge endpoints, and rewrites the lexicographical tie-breaker as a recursive sequence. Models that fail to algebraically simplify these will implement an exhaustive search over all valid configurations to evaluate the tie-breaker, leading to an unavoidable Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) on 40 nodes.
